Metres, seconds. brain: how far people and dogs are avoided, walk / flee speeds, how long walks and rests last, the range kept to; rest_actions: what each species does in turn when resting; threat_action: what a cat does when a dog is near but not too near (else it flees). review: an action entry walks until walk_until, does the action until hold_until, walks on, over cycle; walk / trot entries wander (trot at trot_speed_fraction of the top speed); the view is frame x the model's longest side high (behaviour_camera_size for behaviour); behaviour: people walk the routes in people ([x, z, speed along x], repeating every people_period), drawn with the person_* sizes, a dog approaches a cat from approach_start, the animal keeps within range_radius of range_center, for behaviour_duration. frames / capture_every: tools/record_animals.py. checks (tools/check_animals.gd): largest leg bone length change (m), largest distance of a walking paw from where the gait planted it (m), fastest any joint may move (m/s).
